βουληφόροι: βουληφόρος — counsel-bearing, deliberative (βουλή ’counsel’ + φέρω); adj. of two endings, fem. nom. pl. (of assemblies) · also masc. nom. pl. as a noun: ’counsellors’ (Φαιήκων βουληφόροι ’the Phaeacians’ counsellors’)
δέδεντο: δέω — bind, tie; plpf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδέδεντο): ’had been tied, were tied’
δαείω: δάω — learn, come to know (aor. ἐδάην); aor. 2 pass. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened (δαείω = Attic δαῶ, cf. μάθω)
δωσέμεναι: δίδωμι — give; fut. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic δώσειν): ’that he would give’
δῖοί: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. pl., accented before enclitic τε (cf. δῖοι)
εἰσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl. (Attic εἰσί(ν)): ’they are’
εἴρεαι: εἴρομαι — ask; pres. 2 sg., epic by-form of ἔρομαι, uncontracted ending (= Attic ἔρῃ)
εἶσθα: εἶμι — go; pres. 2 sg., epic -σθα (= Attic εἶ), with future sense: ’you will go’
εὐναί: εὐνή — couch, bed; fem. nom. pl.
εὕδουσ: εὕδω — sleep, lie asleep; pres. 3 pl., elided (εὕδουσ’ = εὕδουσι): ’they sleep’
θείειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic θείειν (= Attic θεῖν): ’to run’ (πέρι θείειν ταχύς ’exceedingly swift to run’)
θείου: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg.
θνητοῖσι: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
καλλίστους: καλός — beautiful, fair; superl. καλλίστους, masc. acc. pl.: ’the fairest’
λάθοι: λανθάνω — escape the notice of, elude; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might escape notice, might slip by’
λύ: λύω — loose, unyoke; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (λύ’ = λῦε)
μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ: ’in the middle of the sea’ · also used alone as a noun, ’in the middle’ (ἐν μέσῳ ’in the middle’) · also masc. dat. sg., agreeing with a noun of place: ’in the middle of’ (the gathering)
πέμψον: πέμπω — send, send on one’s way, escort; aor. imper. 2 sg.
παρὲκ: παρέκ — out along, beyond, outside (+ gen.); prep., epic = παρά + ἐκ
πελασγοί: Πελασγοί — the Pelasgians, an old people; masc. nom. pl.
πελώρια: πελώριος — monstrous, huge, prodigious; adj., neut. nom. pl., agreeing with κύματα
πηλεΐωνος: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., patronymic
πρώτην: πρῶτος — first; fem. acc. sg., in ἐς πρώτην ’to the first (person)’ · also fem. acc. sg. agreeing with an understood object ’her’: πρώτην ἱκέτευσας ’you besought her first’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a named object, ’first’ (πρώτην Τυρὼ ἴδον ’I saw Tyro first’)
τοῖσδεσσι: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
φθεγγομένου: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, speak; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. gen. sg., gen. absolute: ’as he was speaking’
φυλάσσει: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over, keep; pres. 3 sg.
φυλάσσειν: φυλάσσω — guard, keep, watch over; pres. inf.: ’to keep’
χρυσῷ: χρυσός — gold; masc. dat. sg.: ’with gold’
ἀγγείλας: ἀγγέλλω — announce, report; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having reported’
ἀθανάτη: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic ἀθάνατος, two-ending), epithet of Circe
ἀνέμοισιν: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἐπεμαίετο: ἐπιμαίομαι — feel over, touch, grope over; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted: ’was feeling over’
ἐσθλά: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; neut. acc. pl.
ἐφώνησεν: φωνέω — utter, speak, give voice to; aor. 3 sg.
ἑστάμεναι: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. inf. intrans., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἑστάναι): ’to stand’
ἔειπον: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 1 sg., epic ἔειπον (= Attic εἶπον) · also aor. 3 pl. (same ending): ’they called, said’ (μιν ἐσθλὸν ἔειπον ’call him good’)
ἔλαχον: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, get as one’s share; aor. 1 sg. or 3 pl., + gen. of the share
ἔσσεαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg., epic ἔσσεαι (= Attic ἔσῃ): ’you will be’
ἔσχατοι: ἔσχατος — farthest, outermost, last; masc. nom. pl.
ἴλου: Ἶλος — Ilus, son of Mermerus, in Ephyra; gen. sg.
ὁμοῖοι: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’like (their father)’
ὅσσαι: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much as, as many as; fem. nom. pl., epic geminated form ὅσσαι (= ὅσαι)
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
